texts.facts: 2. The mother of the 1st petitioner is in possession of 1.44 Ares of land comprised in Re-survey No.182/9 in the 1st respondent Panchayat. The mother of the 1st petitioner and the 2nd petitioner have entered into an agreement of lease, whereby the 2nd petitioner is running a tea stall in the above property. Now, the 2nd respondent has issued Ext.P6 notice to the 1 st petitioner, alleging that he is running an unauthorised commercial activity and to stop the activity. Even though the 2nd petitioner applied for a licence, the same has been rejected by the 2nd respondent. Subsequently, Ext.P7 notice has again been issued to the 1 st petitioner, to demolish the construction. The 1st respondent has also affixed Ext.P8 notice on the tea stall of the 2 nd petitioner, 2025:KER:43679 threatening to demolish the unauthorised construction. Exts.P6 to P8 notices are illegal and arbitrary.
